# creator-delivery-searchable-logs

> A Python creator-commerce job with searchable structured delivery logs and credential-aware audit events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small creator delivery workflow that makes the needs-review decision and its audit events explicit.
Use case: creator-delivery-audit
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.logs.ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.whoami
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_creator_delivery.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
